facts.fact: The Congo ministry of social affairs reports the Registre Social Unique headquarters was inaugurated on 10 April 2026 and, in the minister's words, programmes now have a common source of information through it.
The minister says that thanks to the RSU the assistance programmes, universal health insurance, social safety nets and insertion projects, now have a common source of information.
